channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period include Prisa Group's $77 million dual-brand Hilton hotel opening in the San Juan Convention District, Toyota's $55 million Toa Baja distribution expansion, and Energy Bureau approval of an 80 MW solar plus 400 MWh storage project in Guánica backed by about $300 million in financing. Isla Grande airport also advances with $25.6 million in federal runway funds and an initial $8 million private commitment. Accelerant became the first international reinsurer under Act 130-2025, and Evertec, Popular and the island's banks posted strong results. Risks center on New Fortress Energy's LNG supply running out, which forces diesel burning and prompts the government to negotiate with Crowley and Naturgy, and on Yum! Brands ending its franchise with Encanto, which closed all KFC and Taco Bell restaurants and put thousands of jobs at risk.
